Running head centred at top with page number 477 at upper right. Dictionary entries in paragraphs; a large woodcut initial O at left of the lower section.

main_text.p: 2.v.29.41. Achab,191. Ministri viri Dei, 2 Reg.6.15. Regi Assyriorum,17.26. Eliacim,&c. 18.37. Nuntij Iosaphat,2 Paralip.20.2. relictis captiuis, Nehem.1.3. Eunuchi, Esth. 4.4. Nuncij Iob, Iob.1.v.14.15.&c. Esaias, Esa.38.8. Discipuli Ioannis, Matth.14.12. Principi Synagogæ, Lucæ 8.49.

NVPTIAE, pro conuiuio nuptiali, Matth.22.8. pro loco nuptiis celebrandis destinato,25.10. allegoricè, pro vita beata & immortali, ibid. Apoc.19.9. Nuptię celebrantur, Gen. 29.22. Iudic.14.10. Ioan.2.v.1.2.

Nuptiarum Secundarum exempla: Abraham, Gen.25.1. Abigail, 1 Sam.25.42. Assuerus, Esth.2.17. Nuptiis interfuit Christus, Ioann.2.2. Nuptiarum parabola, Matth.22.11. Nuptialis vestis fides, ibid. ad nuptias Agni vocati, beati, Apoc.19.9. Nuptias benedicendi formula, Gen.24.60. Ruth.4.11.
NVTRIX vt fouet suos liberos, sic Paulus Theßalonicenses, nihil ab eis exigens, 1 Thess.2.7. [Nux mystica, Cantic. 6.7.]
NYCTICORAX: eo non vescuntur Iudæi, Deuter. 14.7.
main_text.head: O
main_text.p: BED, filius Booz ex Ruth, nascitur, Ruth. 4.13. suscipitur à Noemi, ver.16. nomen illi imponunt vicinæ, verf.17. Obed Dauidis auus, v.17.18. (i. seruiens.)
OBED-EDOM Gethæus, Arcam domo excipit, 2 Samu. 6.11. ob id à Deo benedicitur, ibid. & verf. 12. (id est seruiens terræ.)

page.notes: Marginal text in the left margin is faint and largely illegible; the facing page strip at the far left was not transcribed. Dense Latin Scripture references in the lower entries are transcribed as printed but may contain small errors from the scan.
